files.summary: Defines the SiteDocument data object for linking documents to a Site by numeric IDs. No workflow or UI logic, only data model.
files.purpose: Data model representing documents associated with a site.

files.summary: ASP.NET page to display and filter employment applications for staff administrators. Provides filtering by site, discipline, date range, status, with validation and error/warning UIs. Includes data binding, dropdowns, calendars, and paging.
files.purpose: Enable staff administrators to view, filter, and manage submitted employment applications.

workflows.name: Filter Employment Applications
steps: Select Site and Discipline from dropdowns.
Enter Start and End dates; use calendar controls if needed.
Toggle 'Show Withdrawn' checkbox.
Click 'Refresh View' to update grid.
Application grid displays filtered results with columns: Name, Program, Site, Submitted Date, Status, Withdrawn Date.
Click application for more details or email.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications can be shown or hidden via checkbox.
Date range must be valid (StartDate <= EndDate).
conditions: 'Show Withdrawn' determines if withdrawn applications appear.
Dropdowns can be filtered by agency context.
system_behavior: Client-side and server-side validation for user input.
Error and warning panels display issues; can be dismissed.
exceptions: Data source select can be cancelled if session is missing.

files.summary: Data model and business methods for service codes, including localization and categorized retrieval. ServiceCode includes fields for categorization, naming, sorting, and alternates for localization.
files.purpose: Provide a system for managing and retrieving service codes with support for alternate language fields.

workflows.name: Retrieve All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all codes.
Localize Name to alternate language if session flag is set.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes By Course
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with CourseID.
Return codes linked to the course.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes By Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with TimetableID.
Return codes linked to the timetable.

business_rules: Alternate language Used if session flag UseAltLanguageFields is set.

files.summary: Tracks history of changes to Site profiles, including who made the change, when, and which fields changed. Supports localization for field/section/action names. Exposes methods to query the audit log for a Site.
files.purpose: Audit log for site profile changes, showing history for review or compliance.

workflows.name: Query Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and AgencyID.
System retrieves change events for the site with meta-data.

business_rules: If support team or sysadmin made the change, format display accordingly.
Display name and agency with optional phone for actor details.
conditions: Localization fields used if alternate language is in effect.
system_behavior: Maintains a log of site profile changes.

files.summary: Data model and static methods for managing email popup documents (attachments), supporting operations to search and delete by string-based encoded info.
files.purpose: Enable storing, retrieving, and deleting lists of documents shown in an email UI popup.

workflows.name: Parse Email Popup Document List
steps: Split DataInfo string by '|'.
For each entry, split by '>' to get FileName and FilePath.
Build EmailPopupDocument objects for list.

workflows.name: Delete an Email Popup Document
steps: Identify document by array index (ID).
Delete corresponding file at FilePath.
Attempt to delete containing folder (ignore errors).
Rebuild DataInfo string without deleted entry.

business_rules: Folders/files are deleted only when all references are removed.
